text: Helios Robotics Q3 2025 earnings. Revenue was $47.2 million, up 18 percent year over year. North America contributed 61 percent of revenue. The company ended the quarter with $29.4 million in cash.
Atlas-2 warehouse robots shipped 2140 units in Q3 2025. Gross margin was 34.1 percent. Service contracts covered 71 percent of the installed Atlas-2 fleet.
Management published Q4 2025 revenue guidance of $51 to $54 million. A hiring freeze applies to the marketing organization through January 2026. No other regional guidance was issued.
Atlas-2 emergency stop policy. The robot must come to a full stop within 0.4 seconds of obstacle detection. Operators recertify on the safety course every 12 months.
Lithium battery packs for Atlas robots must be stored below 30 Celsius. Any safety incident must be reported to the duty officer within 4 hours of discovery.
The board delayed the Atlas-3 launch from March 2026 to September 2026 because actuator yield stayed below the 92 percent gate. No Atlas-3 list price was approved.
Directors approved $6.5 million for battery vendor dual-sourcing in fiscal 2026. The vote was unanimous. The committee asked for a supplier shortlist by 15 November 2025.
Helios contracted VoltForge Ltd for 18 months at 40000 cells per month and $12.40 per cell. The contract begins 1 October 2025. No other cell vendor is named in this agreement.
Either party may terminate the VoltForge agreement for convenience with 90 days written notice. On-time delivery SLA is 99.2 percent measured monthly.
